observed_result: Authorized tenant export implemented (POST /api/settings/export, owner session + CSRF; agents 403; preview without audit; zip of journal JSON lines + evidence metadata with per-object ledger status + settings/retention; 64 MiB cap with continue_from). Integration: 30/30 (export 4/4 incl. two-tenant boundary with identical external ids, PILOT-08 restriction, retention, TENANT-01..04); full suite 57/57. Final install: refusals 403/403/422, preview 74 entries / 25 evidence / 4 sections, download 12,490 B zip with one tenant only, no secrets, audit row workspace.exported (actor, categories, counts, bytes) visible in GET /api/settings/security; EN/DE UI control present in the served bundle; locale parity 1736 keys.

command: docker compose -p blackbox-agent-c-ops2 ... exec postgres psql -c 'EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) ...' (reports/evidence/PERF-01/explain-ops2.txt) ; node tests/perf/pg-reference.mjs --pools ~/blackbox-perf-keys/pools.json --pg-port 19187 --pg-password-file ~/blackbox-pilot-ops2/secrets/pg_engine_password --api http://127.0.0.1:19185 --compare 200 --hot 1000 --cold 200 [--explain] --out reports/evidence/PERF-01/reference-{before,after}.json ; grep -rn _minor packages apps (ts-money-stock-grep.txt) ; npx vitest run ... mcp.test.ts (MCP-01 API/MCP agreement)
environment: ops2 install (723,780 entries / 54 tenants), PostgreSQL reached as bb_engine through a loopback proxy container (blackbox-agent-c-ops2-pgproxy, 127.0.0.1:19187); before-run with api/engine 0.1.4 at host load 8-43 (concurrent builds); after-run with api blackbox/api:0.1.0-followup2 (readiness loose index scan) + engine blackbox/engine:0.1.0-followup at host load 3-5; sequential single client on the Mac
observed_result: EXPLAIN: hot order lookup = RAM state + tenant_sequences point read (3 buffers); history page = BitmapOr GIN+btree (258 buffers, 3.4 ms); engine entity reads GIN (251 buffers, 1.4 ms); 30-day summary from RAM (the SQL equivalent reads 63k index rows, 1.9 s). Found and fixed a full-journal scan on the hot path: the readiness refresh ran GROUP BY over the source track (Parallel Seq Scan, 66k buffers) every 5 s per tenant; now a recursive loose index scan on journal_entries_event_idx (82 buffers). Reference SQL (typed payload sums with the documented effect-once/basis rules, diagnostic only) agrees with the API on 200/200 random hot orders and 36/36 cold as_of orders (14 not yet existing at the cutoff) before and after the changes. Full-request latency after: hot API p50 77.6 / p95 144.1 / p99 234 ms (0 errors) vs reference SQL p50 24.1 / p95 34.7 ms; cold as_of API p50 429 / p95 792 ms vs SQL p50 38 / p95 60 ms. No *_minor arithmetic or money/stock accumulation in any TypeScript package (12 files only declare/map/validate/render); the reducers exist once in crates/domain/src/reducer.rs.

(v2, v3, v4) ; docker build -f infra/docker/api.Dockerfile -t blackbox/api:0.1.0-followup3 . ; scripts/verify/ops2-engine-followup.sh <image> <tag> <override> (before: aborted OOM loop; after v2/v3/v4) ; scripts/verify/ops2-smoke-rerun.sh (attempts 1-4; attempt 4 = final images) ; scripts/verify/ops2-restart-tail-followup.sh ; scripts/verify/ops2-smoke-verdict.sh reports/evidence/PILOT-09-followup/smoke ... --write-performance-json
environment: macOS 27.2 Apple Silicon (8 cores, 24 GiB), Docker Desktop VM 8 vCPU / 9.7 GiB shared with the other projects' stacks (host 1-min load 3-50 over the day, 11-31 during the final protocol); second install ~/blackbox-pilot-ops2 (project blackbox-agent-c-ops2; corpus grown by the day's ingestion from 723k to ~1.05M journal entries, owner tenant 171k → ~500k), engine mem_limit 1.5 GiB; follow-up images through a Compose override (engine-override.yml): api blackbox/api:0.1.0-followup3 (readiness loose index scan, agent-key verify cache), engine blackbox/engine:0.1.0-followup v4 (lazy single copy, single-pass catch-up, history-only eviction while catching up, RSS-bounded evictable budget, RSS target 1024 MiB, MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2); built from commit 17494f4 + the uncommitted follow-up changes
observed_result: Engine findings fixed (per-batch state clone, per-batch checkpoint/eviction during catch-up, undo logs evicted ahead of pending corrections → 507 rebuilds per catch-up, two resident copies per idle tenant, structural budget compared against the unevictable floor) plus two API hot-path findings (readiness GROUP BY full scan; argon2 re-verification of agent keys every 5 s saturating four cores). Rust workspace tests pass (release). Engine before/after on ops2: no-snapshot rebuild 196 s (2026-11-02) / OOM crash loop at 1.5 GiB (today, 0.1.4) → 11 s (v2, 723k entries, load 3.5) / 45 s (v4, ~906k entries, load 8-18); restart with a 3,000-entry tail 15 s; engine RSS steady 852 MiB (v2) / 1,085-1,139 MiB (v4, floor of ~906k entries) vs 1,485 MiB median before; golden verify OK after every restart. Smoke protocol (four 600 s runs, 20 clients, 40 req/s fixed, 20 obs/s ingestion) re-run four times: best closed-loop API result attempt 2 (55.4 req/s, success 0.9976, hot p95 1,187 ms vs 2,105 ms in attempt 1 and 7,002 ms in the 2026-11-02 rerun); fixed-arrival runs collapse (success 0.096/0.001) on database_busy/timeouts; attempt 4 with the final images (install ~1M entries, load 11-31): verdict failed, 9/26 targets hold (dataset, restart 15 s, rebuild 45 s, restore 200 s reused, peak ceilings), all latency/success/ingestion/steady-memory targets fail; reports/performance.json rewritten from attempt 4 with environment and limitations. Targets unchanged; PILOT-09 stays failed.
blocker: shared host (load 11-50) and a PostgreSQL-bound request path under the smoke profile; the install's journal doubled during the day's runs, so attempts are not like-for-like; no dedicated 4 vCPU / 8 GiB reference host
